Name: BomberGear
Author: kaniclub
Description:
[size=5][b]BomberGear[/b][/size]
BomberGear adds a Bomberman-style bomb equipment to Stardew Valley.
With BomberGear equipped, you can place bombs at your feet and create cross-shaped explosions. You can then customize the gear with socket items to change how your bombs behave and how you interact with them.
[size=4][b]
Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Dedicated BomberGear equipment
[*]Cross-shaped bomb explosions
[*]Remote detonation
[*]Pierce bomb trait
[*]Kick action trait
[*]Pick up and throw bombs
[*]Upgrade bomb power
[*]Upgrade max simultaneous bomb count
[*]In-game socket menu to view and remove upgrades
[*]Config support through config.json and GMCM
[/list]
[size=4][b]Socket types[/b][/size]
[b]Bomb traits[/b]
[list]
[*]Remote detonation
[*]Pierce blast
[/list]
[b]Action traits[/b]
[list]
[*]Kick
[*]Throw
[/list]
[b]Stat upgrades[/b]
[list]
[*]Power
[*]Max bomb count
[/list]
[size=4][b]Included files[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]BomberGear
[*]BomberGear.CP
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Extract BomberGear and BomberGear.CP into your Mods folder
[*]Launch the game
[/list]

[size=4][b]Source Code[/b][/size]
The source code for this mod is available on GitHub:
[url=https://github.com/kaniclub/SVBM]https://github.com/kaniclub/SVBM[/url]
